name: paylens
description: PayLens root tooling only (scripts, git hooks). App code lives in backend/ and frontend/.

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && uv run --directory backend ruff check . ../scripts && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . ../scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && uv run --directory backend mypy app scripts tests ../scripts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:size && npm run test:backend && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory backend python -m scripts.export_openapi && npm run gen:api --prefix frontend
